tasks.label: Flutter Web Preview (7358)
args: $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 7358 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($listener) { $listener | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; flutter run -d web-server --web-port 7358
